title: Book XII
coreMove: Live the present so cleanly that death finds you already begun.
sourcePressure: The close compresses everything into present piety and justice, the divine within, separating impressions, practice, pancratiast readiness, truth, and clean departure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: death reflection as gloom or dramatic renunciation

sourceAnchors.name: Empedocles
sourceAnchors.detail: Book XII invokes Empedocles' sphere while describing the ruling faculty separated from past, future, body, and external vortex.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Empedocles' sphere gives the mind an image of present wholeness without escape from action.

sourceAnchors.name: left hand on the bridle
sourceAnchors.detail: Book XII says the left hand holds the bridle more vigorously because practice has trained it.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The left hand proves that despair is often only an unpracticed faculty speaking too soon.

sourceAnchors.name: pancratiast not gladiator
sourceAnchors.detail: Book XII says principles should be applied like the pancratiast, not the gladiator who can drop his sword.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The pancratiast carries the weapon in the hand itself: readiness cannot be misplaced.

sourceAnchors.name: mariner and waveless bay
sourceAnchors.detail: Book XII says casting away opinion is like a mariner doubling the promontory into calm and a waveless bay.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The waveless bay is not the world changing; it is opinion released after the turn.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you
tryThisNow: write down what you can control
examples: generic office meeting with laptop and coffee
parent-child bedtime conflict repeated across chapters

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: Monica signing medical directives with her partner
exampleSpecs.stakes: fear of death could delay the truthful present act
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Monica reads the directive aloud, signs it, and asks the witness for the next page instead of changing the subject.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The notary stamp waits beside two untouched glasses of water.

exampleSpecs.audience: Jonas practicing with his weak hand
exampleSpecs.stakes: awkwardness feels like proof he cannot learn
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Jonas uses his left hand for the rasp until the motion steadies enough to hold the hoof safely.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Metal filings cling to the sweat on Jonas's wrist.

exampleSpecs.audience: Bridget handling a final flight before quitting
exampleSpecs.stakes: past frustration and future resignation threaten the present customer
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "Bag tag first," Bridget says, and completes the trace before indulging the story of how done she is.

exampleSpecs.audience: Hadiya preparing trays after an error report
exampleSpecs.stakes: self-reproach could overpower the clean next procedure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Hadiya divide the tray into instrument, wrapper, indicator, and log until the next set is clean.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You see the indicator strip before you see the mistake report.

exampleSpecs.audience: Pierre closing his workshop after forty years
exampleSpecs.stakes: identity grief tries to make ending look like failure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Pierre one final sweep to see that a completed series of work is not harmed by ending.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Pierre one final sweep to hear the shop become quiet.

exampleSpecs.audience: Alice choosing truth with an angry landlord
exampleSpecs.stakes: a false reassurance would buy peace and lose justice
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What must be said if this were the last clean hour of the work?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Alice tells the landlord the unit is uninhabitable, documents the leak, and offers the legal next step.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: compress past and future into present action
practice what feels impossible before despairing
use death to test whether life has actually begun

tryThisNowSpec: Strip one present problem into matter, form, purpose, and the time within which it will end, then do the just act.
